fishing: WHEN: Tuesday Oct 13 early or late preferred. PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks recent reports redfish and snook along shorelines and Gasparilla; surf mixed, mangrove snapper and grunts near trestles. LEMON BAY: mangrove snapper around docks and piers, redfish and small snook on random docks and flats, trout on grass. West Wall redfish expected. NEARSHORE: Florida Sportsman Oct 9-12 excellent redfish schooling on flats (live pilchards/shrimp), decent snook, black drum in passes. Capt. Mike no fresh Oct note. Baits: live shrimp, pinfish, soft plastics, cut bait, gold spoons, crabs.
redtide: FWC Oct 9: K. brevis background to very low in 11 Gulf samples. SWFL: background Pinellas/Manatee, background to very low Sarasota (in/offshore), background and very low Charlotte, background offshore Collier. No fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 16.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD, latest sample ~20 CFU/100mL (Healthy Beaches/DOH Charlotte). No advisory. Manasota Key / Palm Island also GOOD.
fpl: Charlotte County ~1-2 customers out (minor); Sarasota ~0-149 outages (minor, no major Englewood/Manasota spike).
